query:
SELECT
                ((ts - ?1) / ?2)                       AS "bucket!: i64",
                COALESCE(SUM(bytes), 0)                AS "bytes!: i64",
                COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(file_count, 1)), 0) AS "files!: i64"
            FROM activity_log
            WHERE ts >= ?1 AND event_type IN ('upload_done', 'bundle_upload')
            GROUP BY ((ts - ?1) / ?2)
            ORDER BY ((ts - ?1) / ?2) ASC
